meta.title: Clarix — RFQ Comparison for Procurement Teams
meta.description: Create RFQs, collect supplier quotes via form or PDF, and compare them with AI-powered recommendations.

demo.bannerText: Sample data, read-only — explore freely, nothing is saved.
demo.printNote: Demo data: a sample workspace, not a real company.
demo.entryNote: A sample contractor's last six months. Read-only, no signup.
demo.pageDescription: Walk through six months of RFQs, supplier quotes, AI recommendations and auto-approved purchase orders. No signup.
demo.heading: Walk through six months of procurement at Al Waha Contracting.
demo.intro: A complete sample workspace: every quote compared, every purchase order explained. Click anything — nothing you do here is saved.
demo.tour1Body: Construction supplies, office equipment, packaging and spare parts — drafts, open requests, and decisions already made.
demo.tour2Body: The fast, cheap one. The reliable one that always quotes a long warranty. The one that never quotes a warranty at all.
demo.tour3Body: Purchase orders that went out automatically, and the ones Clarix held back for a human — with the AI's reasoning in numbers.

negotiate.title: Negotiate with
negotiate.descHigher: Clarix drafts a polite counter-offer from this supplier's own quote. You can edit it before sending.
negotiate.descLowest: This supplier's offer is the most competitive so far. The draft asks whether they can improve their terms.
negotiate.descUnknown: This quote leaves some lines unpriced. The draft asks the supplier to complete it and share their best price.
negotiate.privacy: Other suppliers' names and prices are never shared, and every message is checked before it goes out.

negotiate.hintEmpty: Leave empty to ask for their best price.

negotiate.hintUnder5: The best other offer is less than 5% lower. Only the percentage you enter is mentioned.
negotiate.hintAbout: The best other offer is about {pct}% lower. Only the percentage you enter is mentioned.
negotiate.revealing: This is close to the real gap, so the supplier could work out the competing price. A rounder number is safer.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Preferences that apply across all your RFQs.
settings.approvalHint: Decide which recommendations Clarix may approve on its own. Every automatic decision is recorded with the rule that allowed it in the RFQ's decision history.
settings.approvalLoadError: Your approval rules couldn't be loaded. Refresh the page to try again. Nothing has changed.
settings.priceAlertsHint: On the comparison page, each quoted price is checked against that supplier's last price for the same item and against the recent market average. Changes at or above this threshold are highlighted.
settings.vatHint: Quoted prices are always recorded excluding VAT, so suppliers are compared on the same basis. This rate adds the VAT line and the total including VAT on comparisons and the supplier form. Saudi Arabia's standard rate is 15%; set 0 to hide VAT.

priceAlert.label: Flag price changes of at least
priceAlert.saved: Price alerts now flag changes of {pct}% or more
priceAlert.error: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.

policy.switchHint: When an AI recommendation passes every rule below, Clarix approves it and sends the PO. Anything else waits for you. This switch takes effect immediately.
policy.daysHint: Slower or unconfirmed delivery waits for review.
policy.limitHint: Orders above this always need a manager, including ones approved by hand. RFQs in other currencies need a manager too. Amounts exclude VAT.
policy.limitError: Enter an amount, like 50,000, or leave it empty for no limit.
policy.scoreHint: From the supplier scorecard. Suppliers without a score yet wait for review.
policy.scoreError: Whole number from 0 to 100, or leave it empty.
policy.requireWarrantyHint: Quotes without warranty terms wait for review.
policy.requireCheapest: Only when the AI picks the cheapest complete quote
policy.requireCheapestHint: Turn off to let the AI choose a pricier supplier when it judges them better value. Quotes with unpriced lines are never approved automatically.
policy.previewUnavailable: The preview couldn't load right now. Your rules still save normally.
policy.previewFix: Fix the highlighted field to see the preview.
policy.previewEmpty: No past RFQs with an automatic AI recommendation yet. This fills in as you compare quotes.
policy.previewResult: {auto} of {total} would have been approved automatically.

held.requirements_not_met: delivery, warranty, score or an incomplete quote fell short
held.recommended_differs_from_cheapest: the AI picked a pricier supplier
held.ai_pick_unmatched: the AI's pick couldn't be matched to a quote
